summary: Captures process-oriented exception authority, review, evidence, and escalation requirements that are not directly enforceable from Terraform plan JSON.

input_schema.description: Terraform plan JSON (terraform show -json). This document defines human governance responsibilities and exception decision processes rather than resource attribute requirements.

controls.title: Human review is mandatory for exception requests
controls.source_section: Section 3 – Authority Principles / Human Review Required
controls.obligation: Exception requests require human review and no automated system holds exception authority.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON; requires human governance workflow evidence.

controls.title: Reviewable evidence must exist in GitHub before exception approval
controls.source_section: Section 3 – Authority Principles / Evidence Before Exception Approval
controls.obligation: Exception review requires reviewable evidence linked in GitHub before approval.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON; depends on linked records and evidence review state.

controls.title: Risk introduced by a deviation must be documented before review
controls.source_section: Section 3 – Authority Principles / Risk Visibility Required
controls.obligation: Risk introduced by a deviation must be documented and visible to governance reviewers before exception review occurs.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON; requires exception record and governance review context.

controls.title: Every exception requires an accountable owner
controls.obligation: Every exception requires an accountable owner and ownership is not delegated to tooling or automation.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON; owner accountability is maintained in exception records.

controls.title: GitHub is the system of record for exception traceability
controls.source_section: Section 3 – Authority Principles / GitHub As System Of Record
controls.obligation: Exception evidence, review history, and decision traceability must be reviewable through GitHub artifacts.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON; requires repository recordkeeping and traceability review.

controls.title: Incomplete exception requests should be returned before review begins
controls.obligation: Exception requests must include business justification, technical justification, risk description, compensating controls, owner identification, and preliminary evidence links or be returned as incomplete.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON; requires exception request workflow data.

controls.title: Decisions must be documented with rationale and traceability
controls.obligation: Exception decisions must be recorded with explicit status, rationale, supporting evidence references, and GitHub traceability.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON; depends on documented governance decision records.

controls.title: Exceptions without sufficient evidence are incomplete
controls.obligation: Exceptions without sufficient evidence should be treated as incomplete and should not be treated as approved exceptions.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON; requires review of exception evidence records.

controls.title: Ready With Exception requires a documented reviewed exception record
controls.obligation: A Ready With Exception outcome requires a documented and reviewed exception record with owner, expiration date, risk description, evidence links, and decision record.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON; requires readiness and exception governance records.

controls.title: Validation agents may validate records but must not approve exceptions
controls.obligation: Validation agents may detect exception conditions and verify record completeness but must not approve, reject, or independently escalate exceptions.
controls.iac_check: Not enforceable from Terraform plan JSON; defines human governance boundaries for validation tooling.
